test_title: PYST 60: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: **Identify the correctly spelt sentence.**

options.text: Scientists are looking for alternative energy to save non-renewable resources.
Scientists are looking for alternative energy to save non-reneable resources.
Scientists are looking for allternative energy to save non-renewable resources.
Scientists are looking for alternetive energy to save non-renewable resources.

solution:
The correct answer is *Option 1 (Scientists are looking for **alternative** energy to save **non-renewable** resources).*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**renewable**" is spelled with a double **"n" **and double **"e".**
 
• The sentence is grammatically correct with no spelling errors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Option 2 has a spelling error with "**reneable**" instead of "**renewable**".
 
• Option 3 has a spelling error with "**allternative**" instead of "**alternative**".
 
• Option 4 has a spelling error with "**alternetive**" instead of "**alternative**".
